text: I'm not sure if this recipe is the best fit for you, but I wanted to suggest it anyway. The Spanish Thick Hot Chocolate recipe seems to be a dessert item, which might not align with your typical preferences for savory dishes featuring oregano, chicken, and Worcestershire sauce. However, if you're in the mood for something rich and chocolatey, this recipe is quick to make and has a decent amount of protein to boot. It's also a relatively short recipe, which might be a nice change of pace.
